label: Diagnose — Photo-Based Module Identification
description: Identifies the actual hardware module from one or more photos, including counterfeit detection. Compares visible markings, package, antenna style, and shielding can finish against the known-good reference set in the HKP. Produces a confidence-rated identification + a counterfeit risk score.

claudeKnowledge.description: Module markings, FCC IDs, vendor logos, counterfeit indicator patterns
